preconditions.description: The lengths of strings s and t are the same.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in s) and all(c.islower() for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist of lowercase English letters.
String s is lexicographically smaller than string t.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'No such string' or (len(return_value) == len(s) and all(c.islower() for c in return_value))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'No such string' or a string of the same length as s and t, consisting of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: s < return_value < t if return_value != 'No such string' else True
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'No such string', it is lexicographically larger than s and smaller than t.
